mutants.description: Mutant 1: omits Kuttner month-scaling factor, returning raw unscaled futures price changes.
Mutant 2: omits month-end boundary check d >= M - 1, producing division by zero or negative scaling.
Mutant 3: inverts drift window, computing post-announcement return at t+1 instead of pre-FOMC drift at t-1.
Mutant 4: fails to exclude actual FOMC announcement days from placebo permutation pool.
Mutant 5: inverts decay ratio and assumes pooled equal variance instead of Welch-Satterthwaite.
